seed.tagline: Turn a Knack app into a rulebook you own.
seed.description: Extracts the objects, fields, connections, equation fields and records of a Knack application into a rulebook, then derives everything from it: the Postgres schema, documentation, RuleSpeak, the explainer DAG, an Excel workbook and the browser rulebook editor. Re-pull it with effortless build -id and the rulebook follows the app.
seed.requiresInput: A Knack application and an API key for it

replacements.label: What should we call it?
replacements.description: Short lower-case project name (becomes the repository and database name)

replacements.label: Knack application id
replacements.description: From the Knack builder: Settings > API & Code.

replacements.label: Knack API key
replacements.description: Read access to that application. Used once for the extraction and not stored.

replacements.label: Which tables hold people?
replacements.description: The Knack objects whose records are people who sign in (users, staff, customers). Leave blank if none do.
